@MagicConstant(intValues={97L,98L,99L,101L,102L,108L,109L,111L,114L,117L,118L,119L,120L,121L,122L,13L,1073741912L,1073741899L,1073741902L,8L,1073741906L,1073741905L,1073741906L,1073741905L,1073741904L,1073741903L,1073741921L,1073741915L,127L,1073741898L,1073741901L,1073741886L,9L,1073742048L,1073742052L,32L}) @Documented @Retention(CLASS) @Target(TYPE_USE) public @interface Keycode

Represents an SDL keycode using the vanilla fields in InputConstants.

These keycodes are returned by InputWithModifiers.shortcutKey(), but not by input()!
